parameters.name: DbType
parameters.description: The database engine type. For more information about the valid values, see [DbType parameter](~~198106~~).

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description: The environment type of the database. For more information, see [Instance environment description](~~163309~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RealLoginUserUid
parameters.description:
The method for sorting the query results. Valid values:

- **LAST\_ACTIVE\_TIME**: sorts the results by the last active time.

- **DB\_NAME**: sorts the results by the database name.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword to search for databases.

parameters.name: SearchRange
parameters.description:
The permission scope. Valid values:

- **HAS\_PERMSSION**: databases that you have permissions on.

- **OWNER**: databases that you own.

- **MY\_FOCUS**: databases that you follow.

- **UNKNOWN**: all databases.

parameters.name: SearchTarget
parameters.description:
The search target. Valid values:

- **DB**: all databases, including physical and logical databases.

- **SINGLE\_DB**: physical databases.

- **LOGIC\_DB**: logical databases.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.
